body_ar:
فتاوي فضيلة الشيخ العلامة محمد الحسن اللددو الشنقيطي في مجال العمل الخيري

من خالا لقائه بمنسوبي ومنسوبات الندوة العالمية للشباب الإسلامي بالمدينة المنورة

10 ربيع الثاني 1432 هــ
body_en:
The considered legal opinions (fatāwā) of His Eminence the Sheikh, the erudite scholar Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew al-Shinqiti, in the field of charitable work

From his meeting with the male and female staff of the World Assembly of Muslim Youth in Medina the Illuminated

10 Rabiʿ al-Thani 1432 AH

flags.note: NOT audio_only and NOT a fatwā text. Every line of this page is a hyperlink to a single PDF, 'vetawi.enedwe.pdf'; the three lines are a title, an attribution and a date, and no question and no ruling appear on the page at all. The fatwas themselves — a whole collection of them on charitable work — exist only inside the PDF. Marked source_is_excerpt_only with the download recorded. The PDF needs to be pulled and translated separately before anything under this ID can display as a fatwā.

flags.context: من خالا لقائه بمنسوبي ومنسوبات الندوة العالمية للشباب الإسلامي بالمدينة المنورة
options: the World Assembly of Muslim Youth
the World Assembly of Islamic Youth
flags.note: The organisation's own English name is the World Assembly of Muslim Youth (WAMY), and that name is used. The article title 'فتاوي الندوة' is elliptical for it, and is rendered 'The Assembly Fatwas' rather than the literal 'the symposium'.

translator_notes: Document-pointer record: the page carries no fatwā text, only a linked heading. Marked critical_for_display so the site does not render it as a fatwā page. Source typos preserved in body_ar: 'اللددو' (doubled lām) for 'الددو', and 'من خالا' for 'من خلال'. The Hijri date 10 Rabiʿ al-Thani 1432 corresponds to roughly 15 March 2011, nineteen months before the CMS upload date — a clear instance of the corpus-wide defect that CMS dates are upload timestamps, not composition dates.
